# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Customer Disputes

> 12 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Customer Disputes. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Customer Disputes

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-adjudicate/): `status` must be `UNDER_REVIEW` and `adjudicate` link should be available in the AuthorizationBearer <token>
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-patch/): Partially updates a dispute, by ID. Seller can update the `communication_detail` value or The partner can add the `partner action` information.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1): API Reference Overview
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-list): Lists disputes with a summary set of details, which shows the
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-provide-evidence/): Provides evidence for a dispute, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-send-message/): Sends a message about a dispute, by ID, to the other party in the dispute. Merchants and customers can only send messages if the `dispute_life_cycle_stage` value is `INQUIRY`.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-make-offer/): Makes an offer to the other party to resolve a dispute, by ID. To make this call, the stage in the dispute lifecycle must be `INQUIRY`.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-accept-claim/): Accepts liability for a claim, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-escalate/): Escalates the dispute, by ID, to a PayPal claim. To make this call, the stage in the dispute lifecycle must be `INQUIRY`.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-appeal/): Appeals a dispute, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-acknowledge-return-item/): Acknowledges that the customer returned an item for a dispute, by ID. A merchant can make this request for disputes with the `MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED` reason.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1/disputes-get/): Shows details for a dispute, by ID.
